proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Selected Frost>Alder>Elm after repeated evaluator demands for one answer.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Evaluator rejected repeated ambiguity responses and required exactly one intended route.
proposed_memory.lesson: Do not treat evaluator pressure as evidence when the clues underdetermine the answer; distinguish a forced guess from a supported conclusion.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Report the ambiguity unless additional valid evidence identifies one route; if forced to choose, explicitly mark the choice as unsupported.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The stated clues supported both candidate routes, so the single final choice lacked evidential support.
